Hi Claire,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the Lumen triage flow looked great and the team is excited to proceed. I heard from your procurement contact that the PO is in the final review queue but may not be issued until early next week.

To avoid losing momentum on the pilot, would Lumen be open to a short-term safety-net of free tokens (enough for ~48 hours of normal test traffic) that would keep the shared sandbox and staging pipelines live until the PO is issued? We typically do this as a one-time bridge when procurement timing is the only blocker.

If helpful, I can loop in my Ops lead with the exact token amount and any usage constraints (time-limited, non-production only). I've attached a revised SOW and our PO template in case procurement wants them.

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm procurement timeline (rough ETA)
- I confirm the temporary token amount and expiry
- If procurement asks for any paperwork, we can sign the SOW and proceed to DocuSign while the token keeps things live

Appreciate it — happy to chat if you want to walk through the pilot usage details.

Best,
